I added a dataset-level filter to DataSet1 so it only returns rows where `EquipmentType` equals `Excavator`. The filter sits on the dataset, so every consumer (FleetTable, the TotalHoursValue total, and HoursBySite chart) will see only excavators.

I didn't change the DAX query or any layout. The match is exact and case-sensitive as written, so if the source stores values like "excavator" or "Excavator " with a trailing space, no rows will come through. I haven't run the report against the data to confirm the values.
